description: K₂NaMoO₃F₃ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4₂nm space group. K is bonded to six O and six F atoms to form KO₆F₆ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent KO₆F₆ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent KO₆F₆ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₃F₃ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent MoO₃F₃ octahedra. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.89-3.23 Å. There are four shorter (3.01 Å) and two longer (3.07 Å) K-F bond lengths. Na is bonded to three O and three F atoms to form NaO₃F₃ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MoO₃F₃ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent KO₆F₆ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-16°. There is one shorter (2.41 Å) and two longer (2.46 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are two shorter (2.25 Å) and one longer (2.26 Å) Na-F bond length. Mo is bonded to three O and three F atoms to form MoO₃F₃ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₃F₃ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent KO₆F₆ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-16°. There is one shorter (1.78 Å) and two longer (1.85 Å) Mo-O bond lengths. There are two shorter (2.02 Å) and one longer (2.23 Å) Mo-F bond length. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four equivalent K, one Na, and one Mo atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to four equivalent K, one Na, and one Mo atom. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four equivalent K, one Na, and one Mo atom. In the second F site, F is bonded to four equivalent K, one Na, and one Mo atom to form distorted corner-sharing FK₄NaMo octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 2°.
